notes.akola: He or she: no prefix in the present.

tips.title: I, you, he, we, they
body: The person goes on the front of the verb. With **tiyo** (to work):

tips.title: Lacen: afterwards
body: Link your day with **ci** (and then) and **lacen** (afterwards): **Acoo, ci acamo cam me odiko. Lacen akwano.**
**Kare ducu** (every time) means always, and **nino ducu** (every day) daily.

culture.title: Chores are shared
body: Children sweep the compound (**ywe**) and fetch water before school, and everyone helps to wash dishes after the evening meal. Thank them with **Itimo maber!** (you’ve done well).
